info.title: fomo API
info.description: WebSocket /ws: subscribe with {"op":"subscribe","topic":"pulse"}. Events use {type:"event",topic,data}. Topics: pulse (PulseEvent), token:<mint>:trades (Trade), token:<mint>:price (PriceTick), leaderboard:global. Indexed events stream as they are recorded; prices for other subscribed mints are polled in bounded batches every five seconds. Timestamps are Unix seconds.
